description: List the apps connected to Buoy: id, name, platform, whether it is connected and has MCP access, the simulator or phone it runs on with the host controls that work there (screenshot, recording, app control, real touches) and anything missing, and the Buoy tools it exposes. Start here. Pass details:true for every tool's action names.

details.description: Also list every action of every tool. Default false (tool names only); list_tool_actions gives one tool's actions.

includeDisconnected.description: Also list apps that were seen before but are not connected now. Default false.

name: list_devices
